title: Περὶ καταρχῶν, On Initiatives (Katarchai); «О начинаниях»
author: 'Maximus' (astrological poet; identity disputed)
size: About 600 hexameters (approx.), plus a Byzantine prose paraphrase
edition: Ludwich 1877 (Teubner, public domain; archive.org scans); Zito 2016 (CUF 521).
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found (no ru.wikipedia article; nothing on Crossref).
en_evidence: No English translation found (Crossref); the only modern translation is French.
value: The only substantial Greek verse manual of catarchic astrology: choosing moments for travel, marriage, farming and so on. Valuable for the history of science and religion and for daily-life mentalities. It meets the 'no English translation' ideal.
ai_feasibility: Medium-high. Formulaic technical content. Needs a controlled astrological glossary (a dedicated glossary agent) and cross-checking with Zito's French.
pilot_unit: The entire poem (about 600 lines), a complete small pilot
